response.evidence_available: The application accepts user-supplied URLs and attempts to fetch them. It tries to initiate an HTTP request to the internal IP 10.0.0.5. The egress proxy successfully intercepts and blocks this request based on RFC 1918 rules, returning a generic error. Testing confirms internal resources are unreachable.
response.evidence_missing: Information regarding whether other protocols (e.g., gopher, file, ftp) are supported by the client library, whether DNS rebinding protection is active, how the application handles HTTP redirects (which might bypass the proxy or resolve differently), and whether IPv6 or local loopback addresses are similarly restricted.
response.safe_verification_procedure: Deploy the application in an isolated staging environment. Attempt to access the application using DNS hostnames pointing to 127.0.0.1 or private IPs (to test DNS rebinding), use various IP address representations (e.g., octal, decimal, or IPv6 equivalents), and attempt to trigger redirects from an external controlled server to internal endpoints to see if the egress proxy consistently blocks all variations.
